written: 2026-11-11, committed before any gate of #240's fix round ran (the commit that adds this file is the timestamp): the recheck names floor-limited only at the rounding floor (M1), the stall restarts' count and window pinned exactly (M2), the near field's memory refusal covers a differentiated run and keeps a headroom (M3)
phase: #240's fix round, from its refuting review (M1 to M5, minors)
labels: the fix round's predictions, from the review's runs and one exploration on the laptop (below); the memory counts are fitted by the probe that runs with this file, so the memory gate's prediction is of the line, not of the counts
seen_before: the review's runs (MemAvailable about 14.5 GiB on a GitHub runner, float64, MIME's sphere of 882 force points, a line 1 mm apart): dense forward runs peaked at their estimate plus 1.2 to 1.6 GiB (8 to 9 spheres, 21,168 to 23,814 unknowns); a reverse-mode Study.gradient of three spheres (7,938 unknowns, 4 steps) peaked at 7.37 GiB against a forward estimate of 1.9; seven spheres in reverse mode (18,522 unknowns, 2 steps) built and failed with run.out-of-memory on one buffer of 28.2 GiB

the review's stall arms (float64, coarse spheres 0.4 mm spacing, Krylov length planted to 1 or 2): three spheres 0.2 mm apart, restart 1, every solve stagnated, and with the stagnation test off converged (objective -137.409); four spheres 0.2 mm apart, restart 2, 9 transpose solves stagnated and the stall restarts cured them

an exploration on the laptop (not a decision: the GMRES on the node's joint matrix of three coarse spheres, 1,152 unknowns, 0.2 and 0.05 mm apart): at a tolerance of 1e-30 each column's least true residual was 0.55 to 2.7 times eps || |A| |x| + |b| || in float64 and float32; with the Krylov length planted to 1 the stagnated columns were 6.7 to 6.6e5 times above it in float32 and 2e8 to 3.6e14 in float64; FLOOR_MARGIN set at 4 from it, before the probe below measures it through the node

operating_point.platform: CPU: GitHub runners (4 vCPU, 16 GB, MemAvailable about 14.5 GiB) for every measurement and control; the laptop for the touched tests
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: MIME's sphere, 1 mm radius: 882 force points (0.15 mm spacing) for memory, 0.4 mm spacing for the recheck's cases; 1 ms steps; GMRES's production Krylov length 30, window 3, factor 0.5, cap 600, recheck cap 6000 and stall restarts 3
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: every gate is deterministic (no draws); controls run through detection_rate.py, N runs each, on Actions

gate_7_floor_named.claim: a recheck names floor-limited only where its solves stopped stagnated at their rounding floor (the least true residual within FLOOR_MARGIN = 4 of eps || |A| |x| + |b| ||); a stall above it is named stagnated, its recheck running past it
gate_7_floor_named.case: tests/near_field/test_recheck.py: float32 at 1e-9 (the pair a radius apart) and float64 with the Krylov length planted to 1 (three spheres 0.2 mm apart); the floor probe's arms through the node (probe/f240-floor)

prediction.value: float32 at 1e-9: floor-limited, route 'run in float64, or take the dense route'; the planted Krylov length: stagnated, the recheck converged and within 1e-6 of the clean run's objective and derivative; float64 at 1e-15: floor-limited with the float64 route (a tolerance at or above the floor)
prediction.basis: derived from the exploration's ratios and the shift's arithmetic
prediction.why: a stall of GMRES(1) sits 1e8 or more above float64's floor, so the floor test cannot pass it; at a tolerance under the floor the least residual lies within 2.7 of it on the explored system

gate_7_floor_named.metric: the stopped column's least true residual over eps || |A| |x| + |b| || at its iterate, the quantity the stop reads

control.plant: the old rule (any stagnation again named floor-limited), MIME_PLANT_FIX240=old_rule
control.expected_rate: N/N: the stall test fails every run
control.resolution: stopped columns' ratios through the node: floors at most 4, stalls 6.7 or more (the probe states the range it measured)

gate_7_floor_named.if_wrong: a genuine floor's ratio above 4 at larger sizes would name it stagnated and run its recheck to the cap: the margin is then raised from the probe's measurement, never fitted to pass
gate_7_floor_named.cannot_discriminate_if: both arms converge before any stagnation (a plant that does not stall), or the recheck is not made

gate_8_stall_restarts_exact.claim: each stall restart begins the window again: on the cyclic shift (no restart moves the residual) a column stops stagnated after exactly (restarts + 1) windows of restarts

prediction.why: a Krylov length under the shift's order adds only vectors orthogonal to the residual: each cycle's correction is zero to the bit

control.plant: the review's mutants: A, the count compared with <=; B, the window not begun again (MIME_PLANT_FIX240=count_le, window_kept)
control.resolution: one restart of three iterations: the count is exact

gate_8_stall_restarts_exact.if_wrong: an inexact count would mean a correction that is not zero: the shift's arithmetic is re-read
gate_8_stall_restarts_exact.cannot_discriminate_if: a cap below the predicted count

gate_9_memory_line.claim: the near field's memory refusal covers the run it will make: a forward run, and a Study.gradient's derivative in forward or reverse mode by counts measured through the node; it refuses where that estimate passes the memory a run can have less a stated headroom
gate_9_memory_line.case: probe/f240-memgate: dense, float64, MIME's sphere of 882 force points in a line 1 mm apart; forward runs and gradients at the sizes the line admits on a runner, and seven spheres in both modes

prediction.value: every admitted run's peak growth past the check stays under the line (the available memory less the headroom); seven spheres refused at build in forward and reverse mode with drag.near-field-memory, before any compile
prediction.basis: derived: the counts are fitted to the memory probe's sizes, and the line keeps a headroom above the fit's largest miss
prediction.why: the derivative's buffers scale as the joint matrix's square at fixed geometry; the review's 28.2 GiB buffer at seven spheres is about eleven joint matrices, past any runner

gate_9_memory_line.metric: the process's resident peak past the check (VmHWM reset at the check), against the check's MemAvailable

control.plant: the refusal's headroom removed and the derivative counts set to the forward run's (the PR's estimate): seven spheres in reverse mode is then admitted
control.resolution: the line's arithmetic; the measured peaks' margin under it is reported

gate_9_memory_line.if_wrong: an admitted size over its line means the counts or the headroom are short: refit and widen, never quietly reinstate a size line (#330's 'dense at every size' is the maintainer's)
gate_9_memory_line.cannot_discriminate_if: every size measured is refused (no admitted size), or the runner's MemAvailable differs between the check and the run by more than the headroom

outcomes.written: 2026-11-11, after the gates ran; the predictions above unchanged

gate_7_floor_named.result: as predicted: through Study.gradient's recheck, float64 with the Krylov length planted to 1 on three spheres 0.2 mm apart named stagnated, its recheck converged (663 iterations) to -137.4093030033 against the clean run's -137.4093030017 and the derivative within 2e-10; the review's four spheres at restart 2 (a stall the restarts cured, named cap-limited on the PR) stagnated; four spheres 0.05 mm apart at restart 1 stagnated, its recheck at the lifted cap, not converged; float32 at 1e-9 floor-limited with 'run in float64'; float64 at 1e-15 floor-limited with the float64 route; float32 at restart 1 stagnated, converged
gate_7_floor_named.measured_floor_ratios: columns at their floor, through the node's own step: 0.33 to 2.72 of eps || |A| |x| + |b| || (coarse and 882-point spheres, both dtypes, to 7,938 unknowns)
gate_7_floor_named.control: O2 (the floor test always passes) 5/5, O3 (it never passes) 5/5, O4 (a cured stall named cap-limited) 5/5, R7 (never floor-limited) 5/5, clean 0/2 each: https://github.com/Microrobotics-Simulation-Framework/MIME/actions/runs/42926701899
gate_7_floor_named.discriminating_range: discriminating_range.py on the floor test, 100 draws of the node's joint systems: resolution 4.03 floors (grid 4.55), 0/100 false alarms, plant at 40: https://github.com/Microrobotics-Simulation-Framework/MIME/actions/runs/42926701899

gate_8_stall_restarts_exact.result: as predicted: 9 (restarts + 1) iterations exactly, 0 to 3 restarts, both dtypes (local and CI)
gate_8_stall_restarts_exact.control: A (<= on the count) 5/5, B (the window not begun again) 5/5, R8 (no stall restarts) 5/5, clean 0/2: https://github.com/Microrobotics-Simulation-Framework/MIME/actions/runs/42926701899

gate_9_memory_line.result: as predicted for the line; the counts fitted (DERIVATIVE_COUNTS: reverse 10.7 to 12.0 joint matrices, forward 2.7 to 4.0, a second axis 1.34; every measured case 0.69 to 1.06 of its estimate, margin 1.15, headroom 10 %). Admitted and under the line: a forward run of 8 spheres 9.14 GiB past the check against 12.37; a reverse derivative of 3 spheres 5.12 against 10.79; a forward-mode derivative of 6 spheres 7.12 against 8.81. Refused before any compile: 9 spheres' run (13.0 GiB) at build; 4 spheres in reverse mode (10.4 GiB) and 7 spheres in reverse mode (31.7 GiB) at the derivative's check; 7 spheres in forward mode at the study's second build, by the run's check against the memory its first builds left (8.43 GiB), the derivative's (11.7 GiB) not reached
gate_9_memory_line.control: the PR's estimate (a forward run's counts, no margin or headroom) admitted seven spheres in reverse mode, which then failed with run.out-of-memory on a 28.2 GiB buffer (the review's run https://github.com/Microrobotics-Simulation-Framework/MIME/actions/runs/42919424390)
